EDCS 625.description: An introduction to current and promising designs and approaches to curriculum development from grades K-12.
EDCS 625.subject: EDCS
EDCS 625.title: Solving Practical Problems in School Curriculum

EDCS 710.description: Review of the history, concepts, current techniques, skills, and issues in diversity training as it applies to effective staff development.
EDCS 710.subject: EDCS
EDCS 710.title: Diversity Training for Staff Development

EDCS 720.description: An introduction to the vast array of differences among children, youth, and adults and the impact of these differences on the curriculum, their learning, and their social and emotional development.
EDCS 720.subject: EDCS
EDCS 720.title: Introduction to Diversity and the Curriculum

EDCS 721.description: The interplay of social class diversity, curriculum development, and success in formal schooling. Promising programs and practices for educating children of poverty are critically examined.
EDCS 721.subject: EDCS
EDCS 721.title: Social Class Diversity and the Curriculum

EDCS 722.description: A critical examination of theories of race and ethnicity and their impact on the curriculum. The dynamics of dominance, issues of social justice, and means of social action are explored.
EDCS 722.subject: EDCS
EDCS 722.title: Racial and Ethnic Diversity and the Curriculum

EDCS 723.description: An examination of issues and concepts relating to sexual diversity as it applies to formal and nonformal educational settings with particular emphasis on curriculum, educational policy, and school practice.
EDCS 723.subject: EDCS
EDCS 723.title: Understanding Sexual Diversity in Schools and Other Social Institutions

EDCS 724.description: A study of gender, culture, and power; research and theory from educational psychology, sociology, history, and current feminist scholarship.
EDCS 724.subject: EDCS
EDCS 724.title: Gender Diversity in Schools and Communities

EDCS 725.description: Presentation of methods and procedures to design, develop, implement, and evaluate curricula.
EDCS 725.subject: EDCS
EDCS 725.title: Principles of Curriculum Construction

EDCS 726.description: Study of theory, research, and practice of curriculum leadership as a transformative enterprise with particular focus on embracing diversity and fostering social justice in schools and other social institutions.
EDCS 726.subject: EDCS
EDCS 726.title: Curriculum Leadership

EDCS 727.description: Each student identifies and studies a contemporary curriculum issue pertaining to diversity. Under faculty supervision, observations and interviews in schools and/or community agencies will take place throughout the semester.
EDCS 727.subject: EDCS
EDCS 727.title: Curriculum Issues in Practice

EDCS 728.description: A survey of the design and development of post-secondary curriculum.
EDCS 728.subject: EDCS
EDCS 728.title: Curriculum in Higher Education

EDCS 729.description: Investigation of the process of diffusion and adoption of innovations and change in schools and communities, with a particular emphasis on the inclusion of and impact on diverse populations.
EDCS 729.subject: EDCS
EDCS 729.title: Organizational Change in Education

EDCS 812.description: Introductory analysis, interpretation, and systematic study, using action research methodology, of a significant question or issue related to teaching or administration in K12 schools, higher education, and/or other social institutions.
EDCS 812.subject: EDCS
EDCS 812.title: Principles of Action Research

EDCS 813.description: Advanced analysis, interpretation, and systematic study, using action research methodology, of a significant question or issue related to teaching, administration in K12 schools, higher education, and/or other social institutions.
EDCS 813.subject: EDCS
EDCS 813.title: Advanced Principles of Action Research

EDCS 820.description: The formulation and use of interpretive frameworks to study and understand the relationships among human diversity, school structures, and the curriculum.
EDCS 820.subject: EDCS
EDCS 820.title: Advanced Study of Diversity and Curriculum

EDCS 821.description: An advanced curriculum course designed to allow students to investigate and analyze curriculum studies discourse relative to its implications to critical pedagogy.
EDCS 821.subject: EDCS
EDCS 821.title: Curriculum Theory and Critical Pedagogy

EDCS 822.description: The systematic presentation of classic curriculum works as they relate to current theoretical issues in education.
EDCS 822.subject: EDCS
EDCS 822.title: Curriculum Classics: Trends and Issues

EDCS 823.description: Examination of empirical, critical, and phenomenological methods and issues in conducting curriculum research.
EDCS 823.subject: EDCS
EDCS 823.title: Curriculum Inquiry

EDCS 824.description: Intensive study of a designated topic influencing curriculum theory and/or practice.
EDCS 824.subject: EDCS
EDCS 824.title: Curriculum Seminar
